rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history or background checks in advertising, applications, tenant selection or decision-making. Prohibited conduct includes inquiring about criminal history, advertising that people with criminal records will not be considered, refusing to rent or terminating a tenancy on that basis, requiring disclosure, demanding a higher deposit or rent, refusing to add an immediate family member, and disqualifying tenants from rental assistance programs. A landlord taking any action based on criminal history must give the applicant or tenant written notice and an opportunity to respond. Housing providers must post a Notice to Rental Applicants and Tenants on application materials, websites and frequently visited locations.
rules.key_value: Administrative fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation; civil damages of actual damages or 3x one month's rent; punitive damages; attorneys' fees; injunctive relief

unverifiable_exemptions: Units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back under BMC 13.76.130 A.9
Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley regarding current and prospective tenants; owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record lives in one unit as primary residence are exempt.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt if owner-occupied property of 1-3 units in which an owner of record resides in one unit as their primary residence

rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8 properties; owner-occupied properties (1-3 units) where an owner of record lives in one unit as primary residence; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back per BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.effective_date_note: The page gives the passage date (April 14, 2020) but no effective date. Status in_force is inferred from the page describing current administration and enforcement.

rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.review_note: Official page is an overview; the ordinance text has the specific exemption requirements.

result.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board overview page for the Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (BMC 13.106, passed April 14, 2020). It bars landlords from inquiring about or using criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection and tenancy decisions. It lists exemptions, a written notice and opportunity-to-respond requirement, civil penalties, the complaint process and the required notice posting.
